test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only B sits between H and A. A sits third to the left of D. G sits to the immediate left of D. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who sits third to the left of I?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only B sits between H and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fa29ac80a3a21e121b911fab8013be2c7242e6a1413e65e37e6ef2f081f4115.png] 

2) A sits third to the left of D.

3) G sits to the immediate left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd2ad33b177ff69884bc70884c1e42d3486a7fe6392649ee53ae82240965d9bd.png] 

4) C is not an immediate neighbour of A.

After positioning C only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf10d78f9ffbe893f305976b34a957ae5697e30ea49891680b22fe3538105427.png] 

Thus, H sits third to the left of I.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
